The script for this translation was commissioned from Shiromaru. You can find their translations here! You can also contact them for a commission at Shiromaru#5048 on Discord.

This was a really weird book to work on. It's split into two stories, separated by two 4komas and an interlude where the authors shoot the shit about Kaguya. Special thanks to Shiromaru for finding the majority of references they made (and cutegyaru for finding some more). The script is littered with explanations and TL notes of each reference. If you're looking for a hard-working TL, Shiromaru has my buck.

This book was created back when we only had Season 1 of the anime and Volume 15 of the manga. It's always a fun nostalgia trip going back and seeing the media that was created in the past, back when the biggest running gags were Fujiwara teaching Prez how to do simple things and Ishigami being terrified of Kaguya. It's also nice seeing a doujin that leans harder into the comedy side of Kaguya-sama rather than the romantic side. Both are good, but every once in a while you need to see wacky bullshit this setting provides after all the sappy ShiroKagu stuff.

Also, I want to rant because I bought a physical copy of this book and debound it before finding out it was already uploaded to the galleries. Oh well.
